definitions.explanation: The state or process of becoming accustomed to something through experience.
A negative sense where excessive familiarity leads to carelessness or taking things for granted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{慣|な}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧だ。
examples.english: Getting used to the work is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{慣|な}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: Driving is a matter of getting used to it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{慣|な}れてきて、⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しく→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I've gotten used to the new environment, and every day has become enjoyable.

examples.japanese: {慣|な}れ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{油断|ゆだん}→油断：04085_yudan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{慣|な}れ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{怠|おこた}って→怠る：03936_okotaru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Due to years of complacency, I neglected the safety check.

notes:
The noun form of the verb {慣|な}れる (to get accustomed to). Has both a positive sense (gaining experience) and a negative sense (becoming complacent).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {慣|な}れ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧ — a matter of getting used to it
- {慣|な}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧ — requires getting accustomed
- {慣|な}れ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧くる⟦{油断|ゆだん}→油断：04085_yudan⟧ — carelessness from over-familiarity
- {慣|な}れ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧ — complacency is dangerous

USAGE:
Sense 1 is encouraging — emphasizing that practice and exposure will make things easier. Sense 2 is cautionary — warning that too much familiarity leads to mistakes. The phrase {慣|な}れ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{怖|こわ}い→怖い：00864_kowai⟧ is a common warning.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧ — experience (broader, emphasizes what was learned)
- ⟦{習慣|しゅうかん}→習慣：01429_shuukan⟧ — habit (repeated behavior, not the process of adapting)
